target_success.label: Target success rate
target_success.title: Measure the requested behavior
target_success.summary: The fraction of target evaluation examples that satisfy a predefined success criterion. Define success separately for editing, continual learning, and unlearning; a high score only describes that chosen criterion.
target_success.formula_explanation: N is the number of target examples. The indicator is one when the model output meets the task-specific criterion c, and zero otherwise.
steps: Define the target behavior and success criterion before evaluation.
Run the adapted model on held-out target examples.
Apply the criterion to each output and average the binary scores.
Report this score alongside preservation or retention measurements.

retention.label: Retention accuracy change
retention.title: Measure changes on retained behavior
retention.summary: Compare accuracy before and after adaptation on the same retained evaluation examples. This metric applies when examples have an explicit correctness criterion.
retention.formula_explanation: A denotes accuracy. A negative difference indicates reduced accuracy on the retained set; zero indicates unchanged aggregate accuracy, not necessarily identical predictions.
steps: Fix the retained evaluation set and correctness criterion.
Measure reference-model accuracy.
Measure adapted-model accuracy using the same settings.
Report both accuracies and their difference.
